q1.explanationZh: divide 及物动词“分开；分隔”，divide ... into ...“把……分成……”。

q2.explanationZh: divide 的名词形式 division“分开；部门”，注意 -sion 结尾。

q3.explanationZh: divorce 动词、名词同形，“离婚”，get a divorce from sb.“与某人离婚”。

q4.explanationZh: dizzy 形容词“头晕目眩的”，注意双写 z。

q5.explanationZh: do 是通用动词“做，干”，过去式 did，过去分词 done。

q6.explanationZh: doctor 名词“医生；博士”，缩写为 Dr.，注意结尾是 -or。

q7.explanationZh: document 作名词“文件”，作动词“用文件证明”，派生词 documentary“纪录片”。

q9.explanationZh: doll 名词“玩具娃娃”，注意双写 l。

q10.explanationZh: dollar“元”，美国、加拿大等国的货币单位，结尾是 -ar。

q11.explanationZh: dolphin“海豚”，中间的 ph 读 /f/。

q12.explanationZh: domain 名词“领地；领域”，in that domain“在那个领域”。

q13.explanationZh: domestic 形容词“家庭的；驯养的；国内的”，domestic animal“家畜”。

q14.explanationZh: dominant 是形容词“占优势的；支配的”，以 -ant 结尾；动词是 dominate。

q15.explanationZh: dominate 是动词“支配，控制”，以 -ate 结尾；形容词是 dominant。

q16.explanationZh: donate 及物动词“捐赠”，名词 donation；donate sth. to ...“把……捐给……”。

q17.explanationZh: donkey 名词“驴；笨蛋”，复数 donkeys。

q18.explanationZh: door 名词“门”，注意双写 o。

q19.explanationZh: dormitory 名词“宿舍”，复数 dormitories（y 变 i 加 -es）。

q20.explanationZh: dot 作名词“点”，作动词“点缀；布满”，过去分词 dotted 双写 t。

q21.explanationZh: double 形容词“两倍的”，动词“使加倍；增一倍”。

q22.explanationZh: doubt“怀疑”，可作动词或名词，注意不发音的 b。

q23.explanationZh: down 副词“向下；在下”，反义词是 up。

q24.explanationZh: download 由 down + load 构成，“下载”，可作动词或名词。

q25.explanationZh: downstairs 由 down + stairs 构成，“在楼下；往楼下”，结尾有 s。

q26.explanationZh: downtown 由 down + town 构成，“商业区；市中心”，go downtown“去市中心”。

q27.explanationZh: downwards 副词“向下地”，face downwards“脸朝下”。

q28.explanationZh: dozen“一打，十二个”，与数词连用时不加 s，如 three dozen eggs。

q29.explanationZh: draft 名词“草稿”，动词“起草”，draft a bill“起草一份法案”。

q30.explanationZh: drag“（费力地）拖，拉”，过去式 dragged 双写 g。

q32.explanationZh: divide ... into ...“把……分成……”，into 表示分成的结果。

q33.explanationZh: divide ... between/among/with ...“和……平分……”，两者之间用 between，三者及以上用 among。

q34.explanationZh: divide ... from ...“从……分开”，介词用 from。

q35.explanationZh: dizzy“使人头晕的”，a dizzy speed“使人晕眩的速度”。

q36.explanationZh: do harm to“对……有害”，do good to“对……有好处”，to 是介词。

q37.explanationZh: do nothing but do“除了……什么也不做”，but 后接不带 to 的动词原形。

accept: a dominant figure at a conference

q39.explanationZh: dominant“占优势的”，figure 此处指“人物”。

q40.explanationZh: be down with + 疾病“因……病倒”。

q41.explanationZh: without (a) doubt“无疑地”，a 可以省略。

q42.explanationZh: in doubt“可怀疑的，不确定的”；注意与 no doubt“必定”区分。

q43.explanationZh: doubt 用于肯定句时，后接 whether/if 从句，表示“怀疑……是否……”。

q44.explanationZh: draft 作动词“起草”，bill 此处指“法案”。

q45.explanationZh: dozens of“几十；许多”，此时 dozen 要加 s，后面接 of。

q46.explanationZh: beyond doubt = out of doubt“毫无疑问地”。

q47.explanationZh: as stubborn as a donkey“像驴一样固执”，冠词 a 后用可数名词单数 donkey。

q48.explanationZh: do harm to“对……有害”，主语 Lies 是复数，用原形 do。

q49.explanationZh: 室友们打扫的是“宿舍”，their 后接名词 dormitory。

q50.explanationZh: be divided into“被分成”，被动语态用过去分词 divided。

q51.explanationZh: be down with a fever“因发烧病倒”。

q52.explanationZh: several 后接可数名词复数，documents“文件”。

q53.explanationZh: 大多数学生住在“宿舍”里，宿舍不止一间，用复数 dormitories。

q54.explanationZh: double 作动词“使加倍”，has 后用现在完成时 doubled。

q55.explanationZh: the division of labor“分工”，冠词 the 和 current 后用名词。

q56.explanationZh: started to 后接动词原形，dominate 作不及物动词“占据主导地位”。

q57.sampleAnswer: I doubt the truth of the news.
references: I doubt the truth of the news.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: doubt 作及物动词，后直接接宾语；“新闻的真实性”= the truth of the news。

q58.sampleAnswer: Fathers have little power to dominate children and young people.
references: Fathers have little power to dominate children and young people.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: “几乎没有能力做……”= have little power to do；“支配”= dominate。

q59.sampleAnswer: You can do nothing but let nature take its course.
references: You can do nothing but let nature take its course.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: do nothing but 后接动词原形；“顺其自然”= let nature take its course。

q60.sampleAnswer: He downloaded the information to his computer system.
references: He downloaded the information to his computer system.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “把……下载到……”= download sth. to ...，过去的事用过去式 downloaded。

q61.sampleAnswer: There is a saying that never do things by halves.
references: There is a saying that never do things by halves.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “有句谚语”= There is a saying that...；谚语“凡事不要半途而废”= Never do things by halves.

q62.sampleAnswer: Though he was not rich, he did his best to help the students in poor areas.
references: Though he was not rich, he did his best to help the students in poor areas.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: though 与 but 不能同时使用；“尽力做某事”= do one’s best to do sth.，过去时用 did his best。

q63.sampleAnswer: The city is providing free transportation to the stadium from downtown.
references: The city is providing free transportation to the stadium from downtown.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: downtown 作名词“市中心”，from downtown“从市中心”；“提供免费交通”= provide free transportation。

q64.sampleAnswer: There is no doubt that doing physical exercise in fresh air will do good to one’s health.
references: There is no doubt that doing physical exercise in fresh air will do good to one’s health.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “毫无疑问”= There is no doubt that...；“对……有好处”= do good to。

q65.sampleAnswer: They came up with a good idea to donate the articles that haven’t been claimed so far at the Lost and Found Office to a charity organization.
references: They came up with a good idea to donate the articles that haven’t been claimed so far at the Lost and Found Office to a charity organization.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “想出”= come up with；“把……捐给……”= donate sth. to ...；“失物招领处”= the Lost and Found Office。

q66.sampleAnswer: A lot of poor people were infected with the deadly disease, so the experienced doctor volunteered to operate on them free of charge.
references: A lot of poor people were infected with the deadly disease, so the experienced doctor volunteered to operate on them free of charge.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “染上疾病”= be infected with；“主动做某事”= volunteer to do；“给某人做手术”= operate on sb.；“免费”= free of charge。
